supersession.reason: Schema 1 used unbounded candidate caches, one synthetic lookup sequence, and a JFR workload that mixed publication and enumeration allocations into lookup evidence.

input.scaling: repeat the complete ordered compact relation distribution; preserve original stable ids in copy zero and suffix measurement-only replicas

candidate_contract.stable_id_template: T14a compact stable_id; measurement replicas append /benchmark_replica_<n>
candidate_contract.lookup: actual material, prefix and count index followed by exact T14a stable-id selection
candidate_contract.enumeration: epoch-bound shadow_order then stable-id view of every logical recipe
candidate_contract.invalidation: publishing a strictly newer epoch invalidates caches and prior enumeration views

cache_policies.on_demand: materialize every lookup; zero retained cache
cache_policies.hybrid: synchronized access-order LinkedHashMap LRU with real eldest eviction at 512

client_gate.dedicated_client: re-expand from synchronized compact relation payload
client_gate.integrated_client: skip re-expansion and share the server publication

hybrid_boundary.rule: T14a shadow_order modulo hot_modulo equals zero
hybrid_boundary.eager_partition: hot relations materialize and index at publication
hybrid_boundary.long_tail_partition: all other relations retain indexed relation metadata and materialize per lookup/enumeration

retained_memory_protocol.isolation: one child JVM per candidate, scale, and sample
retained_memory_protocol.measurement: Total bytes from the post-GC JDK class histogram after publication and lookup-cache exercise; enumeration is never executed, so transient enumeration rows cannot be counted as retained cache.

allocation_protocol.measurement: JFR allocation events from lookup-only work after publication
allocation_protocol.zero_event_semantics: A recording with zero matching allocation events is a measured PASS at zero bytes, not a fabricated allocation and not a SKIP.

winner_algorithm.normalization: for each metric divide by the best surviving candidate estimate, then minimize the candidate's worst normalized metric
winner_algorithm.error_band_tie: scores whose normalized worst-cost bands overlap are tied
winner_algorithm.production_guard: Emit a production winner only when the harness parses the pinned T14a compact artifact and all complete 20x evidence gates pass.
